experiments.title: Randomized exact-DP and semiring invariants
experiments.hypothesis: Sum-product and max-sum implementations match exhaustive enumeration on all sampled admissible finite cases.
experiments.competing: Agreement is limited to hand-picked priors or benign support.
experiments.design: Property-based generation over n, k_max, local scores, zero-support blocks, priors, and ties; compare evidence, P(k), marginals, and joint MAP.
experiments.metrics: absolute/relative error, normalization error, exact partition equality, failure count with seed.
experiments.uncertainty: At least 1,000 deterministic seeded cases per configuration family; report zero-failure upper bound.
experiments.output: tests and a machine-readable invariant report.

experiments.title: Conjugate-family recovery and null/misspecification grid
experiments.status: executed real values plus expanded protocol planned
experiments.hypothesis: The common interface preserves calibrated segmentation behavior across supported families when their data model is correct.
experiments.competing: Apparent portability is driven by a narrow SNR or tuned prior.
experiments.design: Factorial grid over family, n, segment count, spacing, SNR, weight/exposure patterns, null data, and selected misspecification.
experiments.metrics: boundary precision/recall/F1 under external truth, k error, posterior coverage, log evidence, runtime.
experiments.uncertainty: Predeclared repetitions with bootstrap or t-intervals by cell and family-level multiplicity control for headline contrasts.
experiments.output: family performance table, calibration plots, and null-control table.

experiments.title: Boundary posterior calibration
experiments.status: executed ECE/Brier values retained; expanded uncertainty and calibration checks planned
experiments.hypothesis: Bayes curve probabilities are calibrated for the declared model after marginalizing over k.
experiments.competing: Low aggregate ECE is caused by severe class imbalance or bin choices.
experiments.design: Repeated simulated datasets with fixed-k and k-marginalized posterior variants; preregistered equal-width and equal-mass bins.
experiments.metrics: Brier, log score, ECE, reliability slope/intercept, prevalence, calibration curves.
experiments.uncertainty: Dataset-level intervals and paired comparison of fixed-k versus marginalized variants.
experiments.output: calibration figure with intervals and protocol sidecar.

experiments.title: Segment-count and SNR behavior
experiments.hypothesis: Posterior uncertainty over k changes predictably with signal strength and prior concentration.
experiments.competing: Observed k behavior is a prior artifact or oversegmentation bias.
experiments.design: Cross SNR, n, true k, minimum segment length, and prior settings; include no-change and dense-change controls.
experiments.metrics: P(k_true), posterior entropy, k bias, boundary loss, false discoveries.
experiments.uncertainty: Repeated-seed intervals and decomposition by prior regime.

experiments.title: Finite latent-group criterion stress test
experiments.status: corrected stress rerun executed as RES-BB-SYN-005; archived 96 percent parent retained
experiments.hypothesis: Coordinate updates monotonically improve the stated score and recover shared templates in identifiable finite simulations.
experiments.competing: Recovery is restart luck, label coding, or collapse under overspecified G.
experiments.design: Vary S, G_true/G_fit, n, noise, template separation, imbalance, initialization, and collapsed/duplicate templates.
experiments.metrics: objective monotonicity, final objective, label-invariant ARI, template distance, collapse rate, restart selection stability.
experiments.uncertainty: At least 50 datasets per cell and multiple restarts; paired pre/post repair diagnostic.
experiments.output: stress-test table, objective traces, and regression report.

experiments.title: Shared-boundary weak-signal pooling
experiments.status: executed supplementary outputs plus fair comparison planned
experiments.hypothesis: Exact shared-boundary pooling improves boundary recovery when multiple subjects share changes and individual signals are weak.
experiments.competing: Gains are caused by forced-sharing bias or tuned k.
experiments.design: Vary subject count, information heterogeneity, shared fraction, subject-specific deviations, noise, and prior; compare shared, independent, and suitable multisequence methods.
experiments.metrics: external-truth boundary loss, k error, calibration, predictive score under a common joint target, runtime.
experiments.uncertainty: Repeated datasets with paired contrasts and heterogeneity-stratified intervals.
experiments.output: pooling benefit/failure surface and model-assumption table.

experiments.title: Nonconjugate local certificate and global sensitivity
experiments.status: real benchmark values retained; certification expansion planned
experiments.hypothesis: Measured reachable-block log-score tolerances predict the observed perturbation of evidence and posterior summaries.
experiments.competing: Average block error hides rare reachable blocks that dominate the posterior.
experiments.design: Construct high-accuracy references, census or sample all reachable blocks, separate truncation from numerical error, and rerun DP at nested tolerances.
experiments.metrics: max/quantile block error, evidence ratio, posterior-odds distortion, TV distance, boundary/k changes, time/memory.
experiments.uncertainty: Multiple datasets and tolerance ladders; deterministic reference checks where possible.
experiments.output: certificate files and segment-to-partition error-bound table.

experiments.title: Runtime and memory decomposition
experiments.status: real local slopes retained; extended scaling planned
experiments.hypothesis: Measured cost decomposes into block construction and O(k_max n^2) DP transitions with predictable memory scaling.
experiments.competing: Near-linear local slopes reflect cache/warmup or a narrow n range, not algorithmic structure.
experiments.design: Extend n and k_max until resource limits; separate cold/warm cache, block construction, DP, backtracking, and I/O; use fixed hardware and repeated runs.
experiments.metrics: wall time, CPU time, peak RSS, transition count, slope by range, residuals against n^2 k model.
experiments.uncertainty: Median and dispersion across repetitions, machines reported separately.
experiments.output: scaling curves, resource table, and profiler artifacts.

experiments.title: Well-log prior sensitivity case study
experiments.hypothesis: Cohesion and boundary-hazard choices change segmentation in interpretable ways without being mislabeled as external accuracy.
experiments.competing: Differences are arbitrary prior sensitivity with no physical interpretation.
experiments.design: Reproduce archived index-uniform and length-aware fits, then vary repaired c/h choices on the same 507-point stride-8 series.
experiments.metrics: k_hat, log evidence within a common model family, boundary stability, posterior uncertainty, runtime.
experiments.uncertainty: Sensitivity grid rather than sampling uncertainty; external annotations only if independently verified.
experiments.output: case-study figure, prior sensitivity table, provenance card.

experiments.title: Array-CGH shared-boundary case study
experiments.status: 43 by 2215 fits retained; corrected raw-matrix comparator executed as RES-BB-CMP-003; invalid parent excluded
experiments.hypothesis: The shared model provides a coherent common-boundary summary across the multisequence matrix.
experiments.competing: Forced sharing obscures subject-specific changes or comparator conclusions arise from axis mismatch.
experiments.design: Reproduce shared and independent fits; validate axis before every comparator; use raw matrix for multisequence baselines and common joint targets for model comparison.
experiments.metrics: boundary summaries, subject fit diagnostics, predictive/common-target scores, external annotations when verified, runtime.
experiments.uncertainty: Subject bootstrap or simulation-based uncertainty where scientifically justified; no pseudo-replication across probes.
experiments.output: valid multiple-sequence comparison table and provenance link to the excluded computation.

experiments.title: SPX regime case study
experiments.status: Gaussian and Bernoulli fits are executed real results
experiments.hypothesis: The two declared observation models expose different posterior regime summaries over 2015-2023.
experiments.competing: Event alignment is post hoc and family evidence values are incommensurate.
experiments.design: Reproduce stride-4 n=566 fits, define response transformations, and predeclare any out-of-sample or contextual-event analysis.
experiments.metrics: k_hat, within-model evidence, posterior uncertainty, predictive score under declared target, qualitative event overlay.
experiments.uncertainty: Block-aware time split or rolling evaluation for predictive claims; event overlay remains descriptive.

experiments.title: MethylKit chr21 segmentation and predictive repair
experiments.status: segmentation retained; corrected in-support Beta predictive rerun executed as RES-BB-RD-008Q; invalid parent excluded
experiments.hypothesis: A family-correct Beta-observation predictive distribution yields a valid held-out score on a scientifically justified in-support split.
experiments.competing: The apparent score was an artifact of Gaussian fallback and endpoint clipping.
experiments.design: Use exact executed methylKit test1.myCpG chr21 source, hash weights/split, implement Beta predictive, keep test coordinates in declared support or use named extrapolation, repeat block-aware splits.
experiments.metrics: total and mean log predictive score with denominator m, calibration where defined, k_hat, boundary stability, runtime.
experiments.uncertainty: Repeated splits with intervals; second region/cell type remains planned until sourced.
experiments.output: new sidecar with lineage to the excluded value and corrected figure/table.

experiments.title: Comparator agreement, tuning fairness, and external accuracy
experiments.status: matched-k CGH agreement executed as RES-BB-CMP-003; non-CGH agreement retained; predictive and external-truth strata planned
experiments.hypothesis: Conclusions remain stable when matched-k agreement, independently tuned prediction, and external-truth accuracy are reported as separate tasks.
experiments.competing: Reported superiority is induced by BayesBreak-referenced labels or asymmetric tuning.
experiments.design: Three strata: matched-k diagnostic, equal-budget prediction tuning, and external annotation/simulation truth; canonical one-to-one matcher.
experiments.metrics: agreement F1/Jaccard/matched MAE, predictive proper score, external precision/recall/F1, runtime and tuning cost.
experiments.uncertainty: Repeated splits/datasets and paired intervals; NA when no matched boundaries.
experiments.output: task-separated comparator table and tuning ledger.

experiments.title: Family-specific posterior-prediction tests
experiments.status: MAP predictive certification executed across concrete families with unsupported logistic-normal failure explicit; model-averaged prediction remains planned
experiments.hypothesis: Every family produces finite, normalized or correctly generalized predictive scores on supported inputs and rejects unsupported extrapolation by default.
experiments.design: Unit and integration cases for each family, MAP versus model-averaged prediction, left/right out-of-range coordinates, zero weights, edge parameters, and invalid inputs.
experiments.metrics: analytic/reference agreement, finite checks, normalization where applicable, expected exceptions, reproducibility.
experiments.uncertainty: Deterministic tests plus randomized property cases.

experiments.title: Misspecification, failure-boundary, and negative-control suite
experiments.status: initial pilot executed; 20-second EP timeout predeclared and bounded re-pilot approved; full suite remains unapproved
experiments.hypothesis: BayesBreak fails in predictable, detectable ways under declared boundary cases.
experiments.competing: Diagnostics remain optimistic under heavy tails, zero inflation, dense changes, unequal information, or adversarial priors.
experiments.design: Heavy tails, zero inflation, no change, dense change, short segments, unequal subject information, grid refinement, approximation failure, and prior conflict.
experiments.metrics: false discoveries, missed changes, posterior entropy/calibration, certificate failure, runtime, warning/error behavior.
experiments.uncertainty: Predeclared repetitions and regime-wise intervals; report reversed and null outcomes.
